newsitem.title: USA: Protein Database to sell assets for $1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Protein Database to sell assets for $1 mln.

text.p: Protein Databases Inc said on Tuesday that it has entered into a tentative deal to sell all the company's intellectual property and other assets for $1 million.

The deal is subject to the buyer's completion of due diligence, approval from the buyer's board of directors, approval of Protein Databases's board of directors and shareholders and other conditions, the company said.
The company makes scanning densitometers and low level light detection systems used in research laboratories.
